evidence_class: Static design clarification against accepted BVLS-03 authority; no source edit, build, test, candidate replay, numerical execution, physical run, or target run
scope: Relationship between the BVLS-03 K/G cap ledger and user-required whole-solve ordered-KKT/enclosure accounting

authority.interpretation: K(m)/G(m) reserve the complete possible work of an eligible refinement face. Whole-solve observation also records unchanged BVLS-02 KKT/enclosure work on ineligible faces without making that work consume the refinement cap.

required_design: Retain the refinement cap ledger. It includes p0/p1/p2 refinement work and actual KKT/enclosure work only for a FaceSolution that completed BVLS-03 refinement.
Add distinct observational whole-solve KKT/enclosure operation and guard counters. Increment them for every actual ordered-KKT/enclosure operation or guard on every face, including partial refusals.

Use one centralized counter hook at each shared KKT/enclosure operation: always update the whole counter and additionally update the refinement counter when the current face is marked refined. Do not duplicate the numerical path.

Mark a FaceSolution refined only after p2 passes the final box, active-bit, and radius checks. A crossing before KKT executes no KKT/enclosure for that face and charges neither KKT counter for that face.
Ineligible unchanged-BVLS-02 faces update only whole KKT/enclosure counters. These counters are observational, have no new cap, and cannot change BVLS-02 decisions or typed-error precedence.
Aggregate both accounting domains across successful proposal observations and typed subproblem/controller refusals. Preserve the owning KKT refusal kind even when the failing face was refined.
eligibility_and_norm_accounting: lambda != 0 exits before p0 construction and charges no BVLS-03 eligibility work.
Charge actual p0 assembly, finite/active/box/radius guard events as they execute, including a face that is then found ineligible.
A radius-equality or radius-active ineligible face retains the actual p0 ordered norm charge of 43 scalar operations and its guards, then follows unchanged BVLS-02.
After all eligibility predicates pass, subtract the exact already-executed p0 scalar/guard delta from K(m)/G(m) for the admission reservation. Do not use a fixed guard subtraction.
A denied eligible entry retains p0 work and attempted/denied counts, performs zero post-admission refinement work, and does not run KKT.
p1 and p2 norm work is possible only after admission. Ordinary BVLS-02 ball-solve norms are outside the three BVLS-03 K(m) norms and are not charged to the refinement cap.
reporting_constraint: The two published domains overlap for eligible-face KKT/enclosure. Consumers must not add refinement-cap totals to whole-KKT/enclosure totals as a unique grand total. If a unique total is required, maintain a third overall counter incremented once per actual event.
residual_review_obligation: The frozen implementation must prove centralized counting, face-specific refinement qualification, actual partial-failure retention, no ineligible-face cap consumption, and success/refusal/controller aggregation.
